For h2h, the 2026 venue splits through Oct. 5 are Forge home 12 matches at 8-3-1 (20-9 goals) and Pacific away 12 at 1-5-6 (16-30). Their last 10 same-league results are Forge 3-4-3 and Pacific 2-5-3; the official CPL preview reports Forge won the prior six meetings and Pacific scored no goals in those six. These are descriptive records, not a fixture forecast; Forge's recent draws are counter-evidence to treating its overall season split as a guaranteed result.
